description: Open the HTTP sample capture file (http.cap) located at /home/ga/Documents/captures/http.cap in Wireshark. Go to Statistics > Protocol Hierarchy to view the protocol distribution. In the Protocol Hierarchy Statistics window, click the 'Copy' button or right-click and select 'Copy as CSV' to copy the data, then paste it into a text file. Save the protocol hierarchy data to /home/ga/Documents/captures/protocol_hierarchy.txt. The file should contain the protocol names and their packet percentages from the hierarchy.
